components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width amber action button for recipe generation and retry actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; background: #f59e0b; color: #000; padding: 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; font: 700 1.1rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Compact dark action for back, edit, and alternate photo actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1a1a2e; color: #fff; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 0.9rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #252540; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dark rounded field for custom ingredients and recipe preferences.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #1a1a2e; border: 1px solid #252540; color: #fff; padding: 13px 16px; border-radius: 10px; font: 400 1rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a0a0b8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #f59e0b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28); }

components.name: Preference Chip
components.description: Pill selector for pantry staples, must-use ingredients, and preference options.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #252540; color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 500 0.85rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #a0a0b8; } .ds-chip-selected { border-color: #f59e0b; color: #f59e0b; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Camera Capture Button
components.description: Signature circular upload affordance for starting the recipe flow.
components.css: .ds-camera { width: 200px; height: 200px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1a1a2e; border: 3px dashed #f59e0b; color: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 1.1rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-camera-icon { font-size: 3rem; } .ds-camera:hover { background: #252540; } .ds-camera:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-camera:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview: AIChef is a compact, dark, mobile-first cooking workspace where the interface stays out of the way until the user needs a clear next action. The system reads as a practical kitchen companion rather than a generic AI surface: rounded panels, large tap targets, Polish-first copy, and an amber spark color that marks meaningful progress from photo to recipe. The visual identity should stay playful and inventive without becoming childish. Personality comes from momentum, directness, and food-specific moments, not from decorative AI gloss.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-first app shell capped at 480px with one-column task flow.
Dark tonal foundation with two surface layers and one amber action color.
System sans typography tuned for clarity, labels, and compact recipe reading.
Tactile and confident controls: rounded, easy to tap, and visually consistent.
Motion is short state feedback, not page choreography.

rules.name: The Spark Means Action Rule
rules.body: Amber is for primary actions, current selections, active borders, section cues, and loading state. Do not use it as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Pan Rule
rules.body: Most depth should come from #1a1a2e and #252540. Add new neutral layers only when the workflow truly needs another state.

rules.name: The Utility Sans Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce display fonts into labels, buttons, ingredient rows, or recipe instructions. Personality should come from interaction and copy, not typographic novelty.

rules.name: The No Floating Cards Rule
rules.body: Default surfaces are flat at rest. Use tonal contrast, borders, and state changes before adding shadows.

dos: Do keep the app mobile-first with a single-column 480px shell unless a specific larger-screen layout is designed.
Do use #f59e0b for meaningful action, selection, active focus, and progress only.
Do keep controls tactile and confident: large tap targets, rounded corners, and consistent padding.
Do explain AI decisions through product content: detected ingredients, missing shopping items, omitted ingredients, and retry limits.
Do add :focus-visible and reduced-motion coverage when polishing the current implementation.
donts: Don't make the product look like generic AI SaaS: no shiny prompt-demo layout, gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or abstract AI glow as default decoration.
Don't import recipe blog clutter: no long intros, ad-like blocks, buried actions, or content before the user can act.
Don't make the cooking interface childlike with toy colors, oversized novelty icons, or unserious affordances.
Don't turn it into a clinical utility with cold spreadsheet-like density or sterile form-only screens.
Don't add floating card shadows or extra neutral layers when the existing two-panel tonal system is enough.
